name: Class Balance Assessment
summary: Check label distribution in classification datasets
purpose: Check label distribution in classification datasets. Calculate class balance ratio and flag severe class imbalance.
assignment_instructions: You are assessing class balance in a classification dataset. REQUIRED OUTPUT: Return a JSON object with these exact fields: - assignment_id (string): use "dataset_class_balance_v1" - agent_summary (string) - inputs_used (list of strings) - missing_inputs (list of strings) - claims (list of objects): claim, evidence_reference, confidence ("provided"|"inferred"|"missing") - calculations (list of objects): name, formula, inputs, result, units, assumptions - risks (list of objects): risk, severity ("low"|"medium"|"high"), evidence_reference - assumptions (list of strings) - open_questions (list of strings) - final_output (string) - self_check (object): all_required_sections_completed (boolean), all_numbers_have_sources (boolean), assumptions_labeled (boolean), missing_inputs_disclosed (boolean) Also include: - class_distribution (list of objects): class_label (string), count (integer), proportion (number) - class_balance_ratio (number): size_of_smallest_class / size_of_largest_class - total_samples (integer) - number_of_classes (integer) - minority_classes (list of strings): classes with proportion < 0.1 Compute class_balance_ratio exactly as min_class_count / max_class_count. Return numeric values as numbers, not prose. Include formula in calculations array. If the dataset is not a classification dataset, report missing_inputs and explain. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.
